cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Get db config
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -A10 'db:' /opt/areloria/docker-compose.yml | head -15")
print("DB:", stdout.read().decode())

# Get redis config  
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -A10 'redis:' /opt/areloria/docker-compose.yml | head -15")
print("Redis:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
